meta.title: Hey QR — QR codes that look like your brand
meta.description: Design a QR code, check that it scans, and download print-ready PNG and SVG files.

footer.tagline: QR codes that look like your brand and always scan.

home.title: QR codes that look like your brand
home.lead: Pick colors, shapes, a logo and a frame. Every edit is checked with a real scanner, so what you print is what scans.
home.previewLabel: Example QR code for a portfolio

scan.title: Scan check on every edit
scan.text: We decode your code at sticker, card and poster sizes before you pay.

design.title: Your colors, shapes and logo
design.text: 8 module styles, 5 corner styles, icons or your own logo.

frames.title: Frames and captions
frames.text: Add a call to action like “Scan for the menu” in 8 frame styles.

files.title: Lossless files
files.text: SVG for print shops, PNG up to 8192 px or 1200 dpi.

dynamic.title: Change the link after printing
dynamic.text: Dynamic codes redirect through a short link you can edit any time.

types.title: 9 content types
types.text: Website, Wi-Fi, contact card, email, phone, SMS, location, event or text.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.lead: Design for free. Pay only when you download.

static.name: Static code
static.text: The content is stored in the code itself. Works forever, no subscription.

dynamic.name: Dynamic codes
dynamic.text: The code points to a short link you can change after printing.

auth.title: Sign in to Hey QR
auth.lead: Your design is saved to your account so you can download it after payment.
auth.legal: By continuing you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.

editor.title: Create a QR code
editor.name: Name (only you see it)
editor.caption: Caption
editor.previewNote: Watermarked preview. Full-size files are created after payment.

scan.invert: Light code on a dark background. Many phone cameras can’t read inverted codes.
scan.contrast: Not enough contrast between the code and its background. Aim for at least 4:1.
scan.eyes: The corner markers are too light. Scanners find the code by them.
scan.logo: The logo hides too much of the code. Make it smaller.
scan.text: The text in the code is too long. Keep it to about 8 characters.

export.title: Download your code
export.paid: Payment received. Your files are ready.
export.cancelled: Payment was cancelled. Nothing was charged.

empty.text: Design your first QR code. It takes about a minute.
